description: This file contains unit tests for the DeviceAuthPayload functionality in the OpenClawKit project. It verifies the building of a canonical v3 payload vector and the normalization of ASCII metadata fields.

classes.name: DeviceAuthPayloadTests
classes.description: A test suite struct for validating DeviceAuthPayload behaviors using the @Suite and @Test annotations.

methods.name: buildsCanonicalV3PayloadVector
methods.description: Test method to verify that the buildV3 function constructs the correct payload string.
